own_solution.law: Transverse Doppler effect (time dilation): photon path perpendicular to source velocity in the lab, f_abs = f0/gamma, so delta f = f0 (1 - 1/gamma) ~ f0 v^2/(2c^2); f0 = E/h, v = 2 pi r f_rot
assumptions: absorber at rest on the axis so the lab photon direction is perpendicular to the source velocity
leading order in v/c as stated
special relativity, gravitational/centrifugal-potential effects of the absorber's position not considered beyond the time-dilation result

notes: f0 = 14400/4.1357e-15 = 3.48188e18 Hz; v = 2 pi (0.12)(600) = 452.39 m/s; v^2/(2c^2) = 204656/1.79760e17 = 1.13849e-12; delta f = 3.9641e6 Hz (about 3.96 MHz). With r = 15.7 cm the shift scales as r^2: factor (15.7/12)^2 = 1.71174, delta f = 6.7855e6 Hz. Wording 'the rotor ... has grown by 3.7 cm more in rim radius' is artificial but interpretable. T6166 and TA7FF carry no number ('a little more'); they cannot be numeric variants of TCFA7/TCAAF, which matters only if they are claimed as minimal pairs. T1355 has no timing clause; I read it as a present change, hence R.
